F1S: scar3 todo sweep 2026-10-28 — 2 engine fixes proposed
1) repo-schtasks false positive: fleet-rogue-scheduler-sweep.py _scan_repo_scripts regex-matches AGENTS.md T1 rule text (lines 20/24) and the FAMES claude-proof-hook.py:260 SCHEDULER_TOUCH regex, so every seat shows repo-schtasks-scripts>0 and MANDATORY directives pile up (cctv had 228). Fix: skip .md and the skills package trees, or match only executable schtasks/Register-ScheduledTask calls. Evidence: _registry/fleet-rogue-schedulers.json repo_schtasks (all hits are those 2 patterns).
2) .fames.previous-* backups: since fames-converge runs native fames_fleet.py converge --arm, darkhero_architecture_sync.park_previous_packages no longer runs, so _copy_package backups pile up inside skill roots (39 across hub+4 seats today, each loaded as an extra skill). Moved them to _delete/fames-previous/ (no deletion). Fix: fames_fleet _copy_package should park the replaced package outside the skill root itself.
Done on scar3: inbox acked (scar3 24, karaoke 8, cctv 229, wallpaper 95; wallpaper review task being fixed), PARK ai_karaoke + new _logs/park/ai_cctv.md (cctv tests 37 passed), fames-converge receipt PASS (_registry/fames-converge/ai_scar3.json).
